job.title: Property Claim Specialist
job.description:
About the opportunity:
Are you an experienced Property Claims professional looking for a role where you can take genuine ownership of your portfolio, join a great team and have clear opportunities to progress your insurance career?

We are partnering with a growing insurance organisation to recruit a Claims Specialist to join their Perth-based Property Claims team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a close-knit, energetic team with big personalities and a genuinely positive culture. The team has welcomed a number of fresh faces and there is a strong focus on developing people internally, with future pathways into Senior Claims Specialist positions, emerging leadership opportunities and broader roles across the organisation.

The Role:
As a Claims Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of landlord and residential property insurance claims from lodgement through to settlement.

Your portfolio will predominantly cover landlord policies, contents, tenant damage and tenant default claims, with limited building claims. You will typically manage around 100 active claims, working closely with property managers, landlords, tenants and external service providers.

You will assess: policy coverage, liability and quantum within your delegated authority, investigate claims, maintain accurate documentation and proactively manage each claim through to resolution. Just as importantly, you will be the key point of contact for your customers and stakeholders, keeping them informed and clearly explaining decisions throughout the claims process.

About You:
We are looking for someone with at least 1-2 years' experience within domestic property claims or a closely related insurance environment. Experience across landlord, residential property, contents or strata claims would be particularly relevant.

You will be comfortable managing your own portfolio, confident making decisions within delegated authority and able to balance customer outcomes with policy, compliance and commercial considerations.

Strong communication, organisation and time management skills are important, but attitude and aptitude are equally valued. You will be someone who takes ownership, enjoys being part of a team and genuinely wants to continue developing their career within insurance.

What's On Offer:
  • $80,000 + super
  • Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
  • Hybrid working with three days in the Perth CBD office and two days from home
  • One-on-one training and buddying as you settle into the role
  • Genuine progression opportunities into senior claims and leadership positions
If you are looking for your next move within Property Claims and want to join a team where you can develop, take ownership and build a longer-term career, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today for a confidential discussion, for any specific questions please email stephanie@smaart.com.au

  • Providing day-to-day support to trainers
  • Updating information across student management systems and databases
  • Assisting with invoicing and general administration
  • Supporting reception and the smooth day-to-day running of the site.
About You

You don’t need to come from an RTO background to be successful in this role.

We’re looking for someone who is:
  • Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
  • Friendly, approachable and confident dealing with people
  • Comfortable juggling multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Proactive and happy to take ownership of their work
  • A strong communicator with excellent phone and email manner
  • Confident with data entry and learning new systems
  • Able to work independently while being a collaborative team player
  • Professional and comfortable navigating challenging conversations
  • Experienced in administration, customer service or a similar support role
  • A current driver’s licence holder with access to their own vehicle
  • Hold a current Working with Children Check (WWCC) and National Police Check (NPC), or be willing to obtain both prior to commencement
Previous experience within an RTO, education or training environment will be highly regarded, as will experience using student management systems such as Job Ready.

Why Join This Organisation?

This is an opportunity to join an established South Australian organisation where your role goes beyond processing paperwork. You’ll work closely with students, trainers and the wider team, playing an important part in creating a positive training experience from enrolment through to completion.

If you’re looking for a role that offers variety, responsibility, plenty of people interaction and the opportunity to grow your experience within the education and training sector, we’d love to hear from you.

Not every Audiologist wants to spend their career working within a large corporate or manufacturer-owned clinic.

We’re recruiting for a growing independent audiology practice in Brisbane that has built its reputation around exceptional patient care, education and a broader approach to hearing health.

This is more than a traditional clinic-based Audiologist role.

Your core focus will remain providing outstanding clinical care, including comprehensive hearing assessments, rehabilitation, hearing solutions and ongoing patient management.
But you’ll also have the opportunity to become more involved in the broader business, including community education, seminars and events, relationship building and future growth initiatives.
The role will be primarily based in Brisbane or the Gold Coast, with the opportunity to support the other clinics. There may also be occasional interstate travel for events or education, if that appeals to you.

  • $100,000 - 110,000 (negotiable on experience) base + super

  • Future equity opportunity for the right person
  • Independent practice with genuine clinical autonomy
  • Established patient demand

  • A business focused on long-term patient outcomes, not simply selling hearing aids
Who we’re looking for:
You’ll be a qualified Audiologist who genuinely enjoys working with people and wants the freedom to build strong, long-term relationships with your patients.
Ideally, you’ll bring at least one year of clinical experience, eligibility for a government provider number and strong communication skills.

More importantly, you’ll be someone who is curious, personable and commercially minded, and who likes the idea of joining an independent business where you can have a genuine impact on its future.
